spans.s:
mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
Much, many.
E.
भू for बहु many, इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made or consisting of earth.
f. (-यी)
A name of Chāyā or shadow personified, the wife of the sun.
E.
भू earth, and मयट् aff.

f. (-मिः-मी)
1 The earth.
2 Place, site in general.
3 The base of any figure in geometry.
E.
भू to be, and मि Uṇādi aff.

f. (-का)
1 Theatrical dress, the costume of any character, represented on the stage.
2 Decorating images, temples, gateways, &c.
E.
भूमि place of being, and कन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.)
E.
भूमि earth, and चम्पक Michelia.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born or produced of or on the earth.
m. (-जः)
1 The planet

MARS.
2

Hell.
f. (-जा)
SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.
E.
भूमि earth, and ज born.

f. (-म्बुः-म्बू)
A tree, (Premna herbacea.)
E.
भूमि earth, and जम्बु Eugenia; also with कन् added to either form, भूमिजम्बुका, and भूमिजम्बूका.

m. (-वी)
The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third, or agricultural and mercantile tribe.
E.
भूमि the earth, and जीविन् who gets a livelihood.

n. (-नं)
Donation of landed property.
E.
भूमि, and दान gift.

m. (-वः)
A Brahman.
E.
भूमि the earth, and देव a divinity.

m. (-पः)
A prince, a sovereign.
E.
भमि the earth, and प who protects.

m. (-क्षः)
A horse of a good breed.
E.
भूमि the earth, and पक्ष part or side.

m. (-तिः)
A king.
E.
भूमि, and पति master.

n. (-त्वं)
Princedom, sovereignty.
E.
त्व added to the last.

m. (-भृत्)
1 A king.
2 A mountain.
E.
भूमि, and भृत् who nourishes.

m. (-चः)
The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.)
E.
भूमि earth, पिशाच goblin.

f. (-ण्डा)
Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
E.
भूमि the earth, मडि to ornament, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
A horse of a good breed.
E.
भूमि the earth, रक्ष to preserve, aff. वुन्; it is also written भूमिरक्ष, and भूमिपक्ष.

m. (-भः)
Death, dying.
E.
भूमि earth, लाभ acquisition.

n. (-नं)
Cow-dung.
E.
भूमि earth, and लेपन plastering; the clay floors of houses, temples, &c. being usually kneaded up with this article.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Increasing or adding to the earth.
mn. (-नः-नं)
A corpse.
E.
भूमि the earth, and वर्द्धन increasing.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sleeping on the ground.
E.
भूमि, and शी to sleep, श aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Standing or staying on the earth.
E.
भूमि, and स्थ who or what stays.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced in or of the earth.
f. (-वा)
SĪTĀ.
E.
भूमि the earth, and सम्भव born: see भूपुत्त्री.

m. (-स्नुः)
An earth-worm.

m. (-स्पृक्)
1 A man, man, mankind.
2 The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third tribe, the cultivator or trader.
3 A thief, one who creeps along the ground to carry off his plunder.
4 A blind man.
5 A cripple, a lame man.
E.
भूमि the earth, the ground, and स्पृश who touches, from स्पृश, with क्विप् aff.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
भूमि earth, and इन्द्र chief.

f. (-की)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
E.
भूमि the earth, आमलकी a myrobalan; also भूम्यासनी f. (-नी)
